description.ar: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown">العلاج أبطأ بنسبة 15% عند المرض والراحة على السرير.
description.de: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> Die Heilung verläuft um 15 % langsamer, wenn ein Kranker sich in Bettruhe befindet.
description.en: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown">Heals 15% slower when sick and in bed rest.
description.es: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> El adepto se cura un 15 % más despacio al asignarle reposo en cama.
description.fr: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> Se soigne 15 % plus lentement une fois au repos.
description.fr-CA: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> Se soigne 15 % plus lentement une fois au repos.
description.it: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> Guarisce il 15% più lentamente se si ammala e riposa a letto.
description.ja: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> 病気になった時、ベッドで休む際の回復速度が15%低下する
description.ko: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown">병에 걸렸을 때 침대에서 다른 환자보다 15% 더 느리게 회복합니다.
description.nl: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> Geneest 15% langzamer met bedrust bij ziekte.
description.pt-BR: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> A cura de doenças é 15% mais lenta ao repousar.
description.ru: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> Последователь выздоравливает на 15% медленнее, когда болеет и находится на лечении.
description.tr: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> Hastayken yatak istirahati sırasında %15 daha yavaş iyileşir.
description.zh-CN: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown">生病和躺下休养时康复速度减少 15%
description.zh-TW: <sprite name="icon_FaithDown"> 生病和躺下休養時康復速度減少 15%
